For versatile connectivity, it is equipped with 2x USB Type-C, 2x USB Type-A, HDMI 1.4, and an audio combo jack, and comes with a bundled IST Computers 7-in-1 Hub featuring HDMI (4K@30Hz), USB-C 2.0, two USB 2.0 ports, Type-C Power Delivery, and an SD/TF card reader; it also includes Wi-Fi 6 and Bluetooth 5.4 for fast, reliable wireless performance. Running on Google Chrome OS with an Auto Update Expiration (AUE) Date of June 2031, this Chromebook is designed for the modern world—offering thousands of apps, built-in cloud backups, and Google Assistant, while being secure, fast, up-to-date, versatile, and simple—and is ideal for Online Courses, Online Schools, k12 & k9 & College Students, social media use, Zoom Meetings, and Video Streaming.
